## Insert Node at Position in Doubly Linked List {#other-insert-dll}

### Problem Metadata

- **Platform**: Other
- **Difficulty**: Easy
- **Tags**:
- **Techniques**: [Linked List](glossary-of-algorithm.html#glossary-linked-list)

### Description

Insert a value at position `pos` (1-indexed) in a doubly linked lc-list.

```java
public DLLNode insertAt(DLLNode head, int pos, int val) {
    DLLNode node = new DLLNode(val);
    if (pos == 1) {
        node.next = head;
        if (head != null) head.prev = node;
        return node;
    }
    DLLNode curr = head;
    for (int i = 1; curr != null && i < pos - 1; i++) {
        curr = curr.next;
    }
    if (curr == null) return head;
    node.next = curr.next;
    if (curr.next != null) curr.next.prev = node;
    curr.next = node;
    node.prev = curr;
    return head;
}
```
